pkg/chaos/run.go: module pkg_chaos
  public: pkg/chaos, pkg/chaos/cliflags
  volatility: high
  layer: core
  allowed dependencies: pkg_container, pkg_util
  rules that apply:
    graph: a dependency between two modules must be an allowed dependency (ask: an owner may approve)
    coupling: new knowledge across a module boundary needs a balance of at least 8 (deny: fix the code)
    duplication: knowledge that another module already owns is not copied (ask: an owner may approve)
    layers: dependencies follow the layer order (deny: fix the code)
    no-chaos-to-runtime: pkg_chaos must not depend on pkg_runtime
      why: A direct import ties a chaos action to one runtime.
      instead: Add a method to container.Client.
    no-scripts-to-chaos: scripts/** must not depend on pkg_chaos
      why: Release scripts must not start chaos.
      instead: Call the chaos command from the release job.
    docker-sdk-in-runtime: github.com/docker/docker is used only in pkg_runtime
      why: One adapter owns the Docker API.
  exceptions:
    no-chaos-to-runtime pkg_chaos -> pkg_runtime: no date
      why: The old runtime goes in the next release.
not checked:
  fan-out-through-runner: Chaos actions fan out through RunOnContainers.
    why: One place checks the target limit before injection.
